subtitle: Engineering Bi-Moral-Co-Agency at a Substrate

sections.heading: PART ONE — SUBSTRATES WITH THE FORM
sections.why: The part sets out physical substrates (grid, chip, antenna, limb, heat exchanger and others) mostly through field records of each arrangement and its fixing form.

sections.heading: 1.1 Floating neutralling, socially abundancing
sections.why: It defines natural engineering as bi-moral co-agency, each side sharing across with its own parity and rate, and links it to socially abundancing and a free-sharing network.

sections.heading: 1.2 Substrates, recognizing the form
sections.why: After one opening paragraph, the section is a proposed map from Natural Numbers sections (440, primes, 0–440–0 wrap) onto engineering, and it says itself that the map belongs to Numbers.

sections.heading: 1.3 Grid, on the floating neutral
sections.why: It examines grid inverters, phasor sums and a dVOC laboratory record as a substrate entry with its fixing form and residue.

sections.heading: 1.4 Frequency and the receiving coupling
sections.why: It reads grid frequency, synchronization and the ENTSO-E separation record as a measured electrical arrangement.

sections.heading: 1.5 Neutral, selection and delivery
sections.why: It separates sign-only selection from electrical delivery and lists actual return paths, which is a field accounting of a substrate.

sections.heading: 1.6 Sharing device, and the returning coupling
sections.why: It describes rotating machines, the commutator's fixed neutral and inverters as observed devices with their returning relations.

sections.heading: 1.7 Chip, balanced ternary in silicon
sections.why: It sets out what a silicon realization of the resolver's three values still has to build, which is a design going on at a substrate.

sections.heading: 1.8 Network
sections.why: Its first half is the free-sharing network between selves, Natural Networking's subject, and its second half is a record of file listing, build selection and file access, Living File Registry's subject.
sections.home: Natural Networking (the network surface) and Living File Registry (file listing and access)

sections.heading: 1.9 Antenna, telescope and the receiving relation
sections.why: It reads antenna reciprocity, closure phase, intensity interferometry and guide stars as field records of a receiving substrate.

sections.heading: 1.10 Robotic limb, contact and the receiving coupling
sections.why: It examines series-elastic actuators and passive walking as observed contact substrates with their fixing forms.

sections.heading: 1.11 Physical collective intelligence and local receiving
sections.why: It examines a thousand-robot assembly and subsumption architecture as observed collective substrates, with a short aside on Arrow's theorem.

sections.heading: 1.12 Instrument tuning, beat changing and the remaining interval
sections.why: It works out beat arithmetic, the Pythagorean comma and a guitar tuning record as measured acoustic coupling at an instrument.

sections.heading: 1.13 Toroidal confinement, winding and going on
sections.why: It reads stellarator, tokamak and Wendelstein 7-X records as a confinement substrate with its residue.

sections.heading: 1.14 Walking pair, one and then the other, and asymmetric receiving
sections.why: It examines the walking-pair illustration and lockstitch formation as mechanical arrangements where roles alternate.

sections.heading: 1.15 Heat exchange, recovering and receiving
sections.why: It works through counterflow models, vapor cycles, an ejector experiment and heat pipes as measured thermal substrates.

sections.heading: 1.16 Compression, tension and the sign at a between
sections.why: It states the sign convention of mechanical stress at a joint, a short field accounting.

sections.heading: PART TWO — MORE SUBSTRATES, AND THE CASES THAT FREEZE
sections.why: The part adds substrates (language models, fluidic, chemical, quantum, cryptographic) and mostly examines where a fixing form freezes a coupling.

sections.heading: 2.1 Finding, reaching, following and abundancing the geodesic floating neutral
sections.why: It sets out engineering's method of finding, reaching, following and abundancing, with directional discovering illustrated by Marco Polo and head rotation.

sections.heading: 2.2 Binary co-agency and the particular fixing form
sections.why: It examines subsumption architecture, the frame problem and symbol grounding to locate where stored representation fixes a coupling.

sections.heading: 2.3 Language, representation and the inference-time coupling
sections.why: It describes the transformer's computational operations as a field record of a language substrate.

sections.heading: 2.4 More substrates, pacing and the receiving relation
sections.why: It surveys thermal, acoustic, fluidic, chemical, silicon, magnetic and orbital records for each side's own rate.

sections.heading: 2.5 Sharing and construction
sections.why: It lists the constructions still to build (chip, clockless fabric, grid, network, key pairs) and a clockless-logic design entry.

sections.heading: 2.6 Quantum computing, going on and measurement
sections.why: It reads Shor's algorithm and surface-code error correction as field records of a quantum substrate.

sections.heading: 2.7 Key pairs, privacy and the receiving operation
sections.why: It examines ML-KEM, SLH-DSA and public-chain exposure as observed cryptographic operations.

sections.heading: PART THREE — MATERIAL RETURNING AND ENGINEERING RECEIVING
sections.why: The part follows material and heat returning through chemical, nuclear and electrochemical records.

sections.heading: 3.1 Biosphere, material returning and chemical heat
sections.why: Its subject is photosynthesis, respiration, seed metabolic heat and atmospheric pools, and it passes the substance to Chemistry and Biology instead of to an engineering arrangement.
sections.home: Natural Chemistry (with Natural Biology for living reactions)

sections.heading: 3.2 Energy engine and the receiving at each substrate
sections.why: It reads redox flow-cell and chemiosmotic records as engineering entries and states that the nuclear proposal's engineering arrangement is this file's question.

sections.heading: PART FOUR — COUPLING ACROSS, SENSING AND RETURNING
sections.why: The part mostly examines sensing, residue and returning at substrates, though four of its twelve sections carry other files' subjects.

sections.heading: 4.1 Transmissioning, two staying and one going across
sections.why: It defines transmissioning and the coupling-across coefficients two, one and zero, which is the bi-coupling Natural Transmissioning names in its title and subtitle.

sections.heading: 4.2 Same-existing, parity and the receiving interface
sections.why: It is a check of ONE's code: how a prior keeps its size or inverts its sign with each call.

sections.heading: 4.3 Side-effecting recursioning of the floating neutral
sections.why: It lists observed returning arrangements (electrical neutral, heat pipe, desalination, smelting), though two of its paragraphs are cardiac and oncology records that belong with Medicine.

sections.heading: 4.4 Stabilizing and the particular fixing form
sections.why: It reads a fixing form through an anti-windup controller record, a field's own fixing.

sections.heading: 4.5 Sensing follows the tipping
sections.why: It examines event cameras and crystal nucleation records as sensing a change at a substrate.

sections.heading: 4.6 Social sensing and the reporting coupling
sections.why: Its subject is human reporting institutions (aviation, nuclear operators, veterans' health) sharing learning across members, which is a society's coupling, not a substrate.

sections.heading: 4.7 The co-competencing bi-coupler, two-way and one-at-a-time
sections.why: It sets out the connector between hardware and a living self, each side sharing and receiving in turn, which is the subtitle's subject directly.

sections.heading: 4.8 Residue and the returning opportunity
sections.why: It lists a field's residue words and existing recovery arrangements as accounting addresses.

sections.heading: 4.9 Recovering and sequencing at the receiving
sections.why: It works out the three-phase power sum and six existing recovery arrangements as field records.

sections.heading: 4.10 The resolver's same-existing and physical sequencing
sections.why: Nearly all of it traces ONE's code: keys, grouping, priors, next priors and sign operations, with physical sequencing only named.

sections.heading: 4.11 Betweens and the arrangements they couple
sections.why: It counts connections in chains and rings within an engineering arrangement, a short accounting.

sections.heading: 4.12 Zeroing and the switching path
sections.why: It sets four zero cases of ONE's code beside a dead-time switching record, and the switching path holds the engineering subject.

sections.heading: PART FIVE — ENGINEERING OPPORTUNITY AND THE RECEIVING COUPLING
sections.why: The part states the five-property entry as a method and then applies it to residue and desalination records.

sections.heading: 5.1 Engineering opportunity, and the entry holding it
sections.why: It defines the five-property engineering entry and how each breaking brings the next question, a method going on.

sections.heading: 5.2 Residue and the receiving coupling
sections.why: It tables field residue words across industries with the coupling each could reach.

sections.heading: 5.3 Desalination, drawing and recovering
sections.why: It checks forward-osmosis, regeneration and batch-RO records closely, including arithmetic mismatches in the sources, within one design entry.

sections.heading: 5.4 Engineering hard problems
sections.why: It maps Hard Problem Registry numbers to sections of Resolving the Hard Problem Registry, and many of them (equity premium, halting, productivity paradox) are not substrates.

sections.heading: PART SIX — SIGNATURE AND ENGINEERING RECEIVING
sections.why: The part mostly reads further substrate records (propulsion, wave, computing, superconducting routing, model compression).

sections.heading: 6.1 A signature, five marks
sections.why: After a short table of five marks, its bulk is the co and one roots of ONE's seventeen names and the corusing and torusing prefixes, which is naming.

sections.heading: 6.2 Engineering co-chaining
sections.why: It relates grid, desalination and transmissioning entries and reads expander and full-flow rocket cycle records.

sections.heading: 6.3 Propulsion and pumping, the direction at each receiving
sections.why: It reads rotating-detonation, hydraulic-ram and peristaltic records and the continuity relation for direction.

sections.heading: 6.4 Wave, heat and material receiving
sections.why: It reads wave-energy, tidal, kelp, pulsed electrolysis, compressed-air and pumped-hydro records as substrate entries.

sections.heading: 6.5 Computing and fusion, the particular receiving
sections.why: It reads Landauer's bound and Bennett's reversible construction and places fusion as a separate engineering entry.

sections.heading: 6.6 Five design statements, a natural bi-coupler
sections.why: It states the five design relations of a connector between two selves sharing across, the subtitle's bi-moral co-agency.

sections.heading: 6.7 Sensing, sensationing and receiving
sections.why: Its subject is clinical and bodily studies (hearing screening, ventilation, tremor stimulation, counterpulsation, hormone pulsing, light exposure), which is sensor-sensationing human health.

sections.heading: 6.8 Sequencing, recovery and triggering
sections.why: It reads Onsager reciprocity and a Kelvin-relation thermopile record within a thermoelectric entry.

sections.heading: 6.9 Bi-folding, co-tunnelling and the 440 correspondence
sections.why: Its body is superconducting ring, SQUID and microwave circulator records, though its heading and its spiral and 440 arithmetic paragraphs belong with Natural Numbers.

sections.heading: 6.10 Outcome technology and going-on technology
sections.why: It separates a completed outcome, a fixed record, from same-existing going on with the next coupling, and holds both together.

sections.heading: 6.11 Attention and the engineering receiving
sections.why: It reads pruning, quantization, distillation, expert routing and FlashAttention records as a language-computing substrate.

summary: Of 58 entries (6 parts and 52 numbered sections), 48 are within the title and subtitle and 10 sections are outside: 1.2, 1.8, 3.1, 4.1, 4.2, 4.6, 4.10, 5.4, 6.1 and 6.7. The file is mostly observing, reading field records of substrates with their fixing forms and residue, while only five sections (1.1, 4.1, 4.6, 4.7, 6.6) are mostly possibling and six are mostly discovering. The clearest misplacements are the ONE code traces in 4.2 and 4.10 (Natural Resolver), the naming tables in 6.1 (Natural Naming) and the clinical studies in 6.7 (Natural Medicine); the clearest hole is that several sections send their remaining work to Living Improving Value, a file no title in the set names.
